newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Korea Gas to allow foreign bids for LNG carriers.
newsitem.headline: Korea Gas to allow foreign bids for LNG carriers.

text.p: State-run Korea Gas Corp for the first time plans to allow foreign shipbuilders to participate in a tender to build liquefied natural gas (LNG) carriers, a company official said on Tuesday.
"We will lift past regulations that limited participants only to domestic shipbuilders," he said.

The state-run corporation will place orders for six to seven LNG carriers by the end of this month. But only domestic shipping companies will be invited to run the ships, which are scheduled to go into operation in 2000.
